title: Pseudo-thresholds reported for 144- and 288-qubit BB codes

assumptions: pseudo-threshold p0 solves pL(p) = k p
logical error rates were computed numerically for p >= 1e-3 and extrapolated to lower error rates

claim.statement: For the circuit-based noise model, Table 1 reports pseudo-thresholds 0.0065 for the [[144,12,12]] BB code and 0.0069 for the [[288,12,18]] BB code, with the surrounding text summarizing both as close to 0.007.
qualifiers: text summary rounds both values to about 0.007
